_comment: Balance-simulator player profiles (vt-sim economy). Spend tiers = spend + play time; skill levels apply to both composition and tactics. Edit freely; economy constants mirror the contract seed (ignition/modules/DeployAndConfig.ts, near/seed/config.json) as of 2026-11-16. loss_aversion (added 2026-11-17): how much the player minds losing an average ship for good, in win-probability units, before hangar scarcity (see economy::World::loss_prefs). 2026-11-20: the single-player campaign is a stub, so its share of play (mix.campaign) moved to roguelike runs, and the medal comes from winning a run at either Hive ending (m11 The Hive: Dominance, m15 The Hive: Alliance).
